items.title: ToolPrivacyBench: Benchmarking Purpose-Bound Privacy in Tool-Using LLM Agents
items.institution: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

summary.zh: ToolPrivacyBench 解决了LLM Agent在多工具协作场景下的隐私评估缺失问题。通过引入策略知识库和轨迹级审计机制，它形式化并量化了“目的绑定隐私”风险。研究证实，当前Agent普遍存在隐私过度披露现象，即使任务成功完成也可能泄露敏感数据。该基准为开发更符合隐私规范的Agent系统提供了重要的评估标准和改进方向。
summary.en: - **Background**: Large Language Models (LLMs) are evolving from standalone text generators into agents that invoke external tools and execute multi-step tasks. As these agents handle complex workflows, privacy...

items.title: LLawCo: Learning Laws of Cooperation for Modeling Embodied Multi-Agent Behavior
items.institution: University of Massachusetts Amherst; Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories (MERL)

summary.zh: LLawCo 通过模拟阿西莫夫机器人定律的理念，提出了一种让具身多智能体从失败中学习高层协作法则的方法。该方法解决了现有LLM智能体在部分可观测环境中协作对齐难和缺乏自我进化能力的问题。通过引入行为法则并进行监督微调，智能体能够更好地理解任务需求和伙伴行为。实验证明，该方法在多个基准测试中均优于现有的最先进方法，显著提升了多智能体协作的成功率。
summary.en: - **Background**: Embodied agents operating in decentralized and partially observable environments have gained significant attention. Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are widely used for high-level...

items.title: From Detection to Action: Using LLM Agents for Fault-Tolerant Control
items.institution: Imperial College London, Helmut Schmidt University

summary.zh: 本文提出了一种创新的LLM代理框架，通过结合多代理工作流、数字孪生仿真验证和基于知识图谱的RAG，解决了流程工业中主动容错控制的难题。该方法不仅利用了LLM的推理能力，还通过严格的物理约束检查和仿真预验证确保了工业级的安全性，为实现高度自主且安全的工业过程控制提供了新范式。
summary.en: - **Background**: Despite advances in automation, process industries heavily rely on human operators for decision-making under unforeseen faults. Faults often manifest as subtle, state-dependent symptoms, and alarm...

items.title: Agentic AI-Powered Re-Identification: An Emerging, Scalable Threat to Mobility Microdata Privacy
items.institution: University of Applied Sciences and Arts Northwestern Switzerland (FHNW)

summary.zh: 本文揭示了代理AI对移动微数据隐私构成的新兴且可扩展的威胁。研究表明，LLM智能体能够以极低的成本自动化执行复杂的重识别任务，打破了传统SDC实践中关于匿名性的隐含假设。这一发现要求数据保管人和监管机构重新评估隐私风险，特别是在GDPR框架下，重识别现在被视为一种“合理可能”且成本低廉的攻击手段。
summary.en: - **Background**: Commercial data brokers widely collect fine-grained location data and trade it as "anonymized." While prior research established the uniqueness of mobility traces, traditional re-identification attacks...

items.title: Grounded Iterative Language Planning: How Parameterized World Models Reduce Hallucination Propagation in LLM Agents
items.institution: Emory University, The University of Tokyo, LocationMind

summary.zh: 本文针对 LLM 智能体在世界建模中的幻觉传播问题，提出了 GILP 框架。通过结合小型参数化世界模型的精确状态预测能力与 LLM API 的强大语义推理能力，并利用一致性门控机制进行迭代修正，GILP 在显著降低幻觉状态率的同时大幅提升了规划成功率。该方法以较低的额外计算成本实现了更可靠、更准确的自主代理规划，为混合式世界模型的设计提供了新的思路。
